Name: Melons to Watermelons for Content Patcher
Author: saltedcoffii
Description:
This mod is an adaptation of zyonia's Melons to Watermelons for content patcher. Content patcher mods are better for many reasons. See the dangers of using an XNB mod here: https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Using_XNB_mods

This mod loads in new tile sheets for melons, transforming them into watermelons!

Please let me know about any bugs/errors.

Thank you so much for downloading! To add, drop into Mods folder. Make sure you have at least Stardew Valley 1.4.0, SMAPI 3.0.0, and Content Patcher 1.11.0 installed! Like the mod? Don't forget to endorse!

Downloads.Description: Like the mod? Don't forget to endorse! If you were having texture problems, this update should fix them!

Manifest.Name: Melons to Watermelons
Manifest.Description: Changes the texture of boring, old melons to juicy, sweet watermelons. It's an obvious upgrade. zyonia's mod, now for Content Patcher!
Manifest.Author: kingliamb
